goal: The staging area is inspected when a snapshot is frozen and not before: the read-only status projection of an active task is returned with a warning when its scope holds unstaged or untracked paths, the Enrollment gate on both Hosts lists in-scope paths that are already staged, modified or untracked and on confirmation leaves them out of the Enrollment baseline so they are task work, and a scope revision whose entries are all previous entries is compatible. Freezing a snapshot and the index-flag refusal are unchanged (Spec host-owned-environment S3; D8-D11, I4-I6).

acceptance.assertion: With an unstaged file inside the scope of an active task, the status Tool on both Hosts returns the task projection plus a warning naming the path; advance_assurance on the same state still refuses, and an index-flagged in-scope path still refuses a snapshot; seams: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts, tests/host-neutral-assurance-coordinator.test.ts, tests/managed-task-snapshot-isolation.test.ts (Spec SCN-6, D9, D11, I5).

Enrollment over a scope that already holds staged, modified or untracked paths succeeds when the confirmed gate text listed them, and those paths appear in the first snapshot; a path dirtied after the gate text was built is not claimed; out-of-scope dirt stays in the Enrollment baseline; seams: tests/enrollment-dirty-scope.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-enroll-extension.test.ts, tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts (Spec SCN-7, D8, I4).

classifyIntentRevision returns compatible for a next scope that is a strict subset of the previous scope, and keeps its previous result for a subset plus one added entry, for a subset with a changed goal, and for an empty next scope; seam: tests/kernel-intent-v2.test.ts (Spec SCN-8, D10, I6).

dist/imm-run.md states that Enrollment discloses and claims listed in-scope changes and that status stays readable with unstaged scope paths; the generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source; seams: tests/explicit-phase-entry-run-contract.test.ts, tests/claude-host-package.test.ts (Spec D8, D9).
